subject: Platform seat authorization checklist — kernel & cache hires
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platform seat authorization checklist — kernel & cache hires

Hi Kim —

Requesting authorization to open three platform headcount slots this quarter tied to kernel/kv-cache workstreams. Brief summary: 2x Kernel SRE (senior) for kernel-v2 latency work, 1x Infra Engineer (kv-cache) to stabilize prefix-caching across our Dedicated fleet. Rationale attached and summarized below.

Why now:
- Kernel-v2 rollout has projected 18% lower p99 with the two senior SREs focused on scheduler and kernel telemetry in Q3.
- KV prefix cache instability has led to ~7% tail latency regressions during bursts; a dedicated infra engineer will implement telemetry + hotfixes.

Comp bands (proposed):
- Kernel SRE (Sr): L6-L7 band range (total comp target range $210k–$260k)
- Infra Eng (KV): L5-L6 band range (total comp target range $150k–$190k)

Budget ask: fully loaded FY28 impact ~ $640k (3 headcounts prorated). I attached the HC slate (hc_slate_Q2_v3.xlsx) and a comp-band summary.

Immediate ask: approval to create the reqs and commit to tentative hiring plan (we can stage start dates to spread FY28 hit). If you want, I can also split into two approvals: one for the two Kernel SREs and separate for KV.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Staff Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform seat authorization checklist — kernel & cache hires

Thanks for the rundown, Priyom. Couple of quick clarifying asks before I move to formal approval: 

1) Band justification: can you include benchmark comps (two comparable hires in 2027/2028) and a short note on why Sr vs Staff for the kernel roles?
2) Start timing: show FY28 monthly hit if we stagger (one start July, one start Sep, KV in Aug) — I want to see smoothing options.
3) ROI hypotheses: quantify expected latency improvement into customer impact (tokens/savings or infra cost delta) at a high level — even a conservative estimate helps finance.

If you can get that into the comp-band-summary.pdf and impact-forecast.csv, copy Aditya for budget alignment and I’ll accelerate sign-off.

Kim
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform seat authorization checklist — kernel & cache hires

Kim — per your notes I updated the attachments. Highlights below and links:
- comp-band-summary.pdf: includes two comps (Aug 2027 kernel hire and Nov 2026 infra senior hire) and recommended midpoint for offers.
- impact-forecast.csv: conservative numbers assume 1) p99 reduction from 380ms -> 310ms on kernel-critical paths, 2) KV caching fixes reduce burst tail events by 60%. I modeled cost savings as reduced autoscale burn and fewer emergency incidents (est. $95k/year).

I also added a smoothing scenario in the spreadsheet with prorated FY28 budget lines if we stagger starts: July (Sr SRE A), Sep (Sr SRE B), Aug (KV infra). That results in an FY28 incremental of ~$370k (instead of full-year $640k) — spreadsheet tab: "staggered_pricing".

Attachments: hc_slate_Q2_v3.xlsx, comp-band-summary.pdf, impact-forecast.csv

On budgeting: Aditya, any quick read on whether we can reallocate from the vacated contractor bucket this quarter to cover the staggered schedule?

--
Priyom
Staff Manager, Platform

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform seat authorization checklist — kernel & cache hires

Looping in finance perspective. Short answer: we have a partial runway this quarter.

Notes: 
- There's a ~$200k vacated contractor bucket that finance is comfortable redirecting into permanent headcount if the hiring is staged (as you proposed).
- For FY28 P&L we need a formal HC transfer sheet from your org to update the reforecast (I can sign off on the transfer if Laura sends the HC transfer request form).
- Given current bookings, finance prefers we greenlight 2 roles now (the two Kernel SREs) and hold the KV infra role pending final Q2 reforecast (decision by end of April). That reduces immediate FY28 hit and aligns with cashflow.

If you want a partial approval now, I can mark two positions provisionally approved against the contractor pool.

Aditya
Director, Finance Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, TalentBridge Recruiter <recruiter@talentbridge.co>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform seat authorization checklist — kernel & cache hires

Thanks everyone — decision and next steps: 

1) Provisionally approve two Kernel SRE headcount slots today (Kim sign-off). Priyom, please proceed to create the two reqs (L6/L7 bands) and coordinate with TalentBridge to prioritize outreach. HR (Laura) to start JD and req creation flow.
2) KV Infra role: approval deferred pending Q2 reforecast and outcome of the staging plan. Priyom — keep the req draft ready; we will decide by 2028-04-30.
3) Aditya — please mark $200k from contractor pool and earmark it to cover staggered hires; Laura will route the HC transfer form for your signature.

If Priyom could share the final offer bands (midpoints) in the ATS draft and confirm interview panel, I'll loop in People Ops for expedited background checks. 

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Kim
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference
